items.summary: CTO disposition: approve no new implementation work this cycle. Preserve isolation between sites and existing queues; do not retry failed requests blindly, duplicate active work, or change code, content, links, schedules, credentials, deployment, telemetry, or spending. The three metadata-only routing corrections remain the only queue-safe candidates, but require failure-cause diagnosis before retry. Continue Great American Lakes measurement without duplication and record outcomes only at the existing thresholds.

Measurement and reversibility gate: retain the existing Great American Lakes deployments in measurement, with no new instrumentation proposal because telemetry status is already available in the scheduled snapshot. Do not declare success before the recorded 14-day or 100-impression thresholds and outcome capture. SearchWoot remains private pending authoritative source-rights evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, security/release evidence, attribution reconciliation, and owner disposition.

Approve only metadata-only routing corrections for 0daynews.com, allthingsmasonic.com, and americastrikes.com. Engineer must update assignment metadata and preserve task content, scope, schedules, credentials, deployment, telemetry, and spending. Do not retry failed production work or duplicate active measurement.
